Species level refers to organisms sharing a species, not organized body parts.
Organs and organ systems work together to form an individual organism.

A law is not the immediate next step after a hypothesis.

G2 follows DNA replication and prepares the cell for division.
DNA and chromosomes are duplicated during the S phase.
G0 is a resting state outside the active cell cycle.

Ultrasound is an image made using sound waves.
A photograph taken through a microscope is called a micrograph.
A radiograph is an image made using radiation such as X-rays.

Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets or osteomalacia.
